options.name: ci
options.description: Install packages based on package-lock file, same as running C(npm ci).

options.name: executable
options.description: The executable location for npm. This is useful if you are using a version manager, such as nvm.

options.name: force
options.description: Use the C(--force) flag when installing.

options.name: global
options.description: Install the node.js library globally. When O(global=true), then O(path) is not used to install the packages.

options.name: ignore_scripts
options.description: Use the C(--ignore-scripts) flag when installing.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of a node.js library to install.

options.name: no_bin_links
options.description: Use the C(--no-bin-links) flag when installing.

options.name: no_optional
options.description: Use the C(--no-optional) flag when installing.

options.name: path
options.description: The base path where to install the node.js libraries. When O(global=true), then O(path) is not used to install the packages.

options.name: production
options.description: Install dependencies in production mode, excluding devDependencies.

options.name: registry
options.description: The registry to install modules from.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the node.js library.

options.name: unsafe_perm
options.description: Use the C(--unsafe-perm) flag when installing.
